content: Hikɨ Muitsexi Muhawi makuweritsie kanayeyani, Newu hɨriyaritsie kanitiyune, hɨri kwinimieme manutitewitsie paitɨ kanitiyune Pitsikaha mɨtitewatsie, Keriku 'anutaɨye. Mana Yawé kwie kanixeitsitɨani naime mana kemakuyewa Karaha meta Rani paitɨ 'uyeniereme,
naime Nepɨtahari meta 'Epɨrahini wakwie, Manatsexi meta Kura wakwie, haramara Meritexaniyu manuye'atɨkatsie paitɨ kanixeitsitɨani.
Meta Nekexi kwieyari kanixeitsitɨani, meta mayeweri Keriku, meta Makutakɨya kiekariyari, meta Tsuhaxi paitɨ 'uyeniereme kanixeitsitɨani.

Hikɨ Yawé mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «'Ikɨ kwie kanihɨtɨni, 'Apɨrahami, 'Itsahaki meta Kakuwu kenemɨtiwarutahɨawixi, kename newayetuirienikekai mɨkɨ wanuiwari. Hikɨ nepɨmatsipitɨa pemixeiyakɨ xeikɨa, peru 'ekɨ manari pepɨkaye'ani».
Muitsexi Muhawi kwieyaritsie mana kaniumɨni, Yawé ti'uximatsiriwame, Yawé kemɨtitahɨawekai.
Meta mana kaniukateukieni Muhawi kwieyaritsie, Weti-Pehuxi mayeweri 'anutaɨyetsie, peru hikɨ xewitɨ 'atsipɨkatimate hakewa mekateukie.
Kepauka Muitsexi mumɨ xeitsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari wiyari pexeiyakai. Peru pɨtɨrɨkaɨyekai meta 'aixɨa pɨreunierekai 'akuxi.
Xeitewiyari heimana tamamata tukari mepuyuri me'utitsuatɨ 'Ixaheritsixi, Muitsexi hetsiemieme Muhawi makuweritsie, mɨpaɨ paɨmexɨa tukari mepeyuhiweriekai mɨkɨ kememɨte'uhukai.

Hikɨ Kutsuhexi Nuni nu'aya 'iyari timaiwemekɨ kaniutahɨne, Muitsexi meripaitɨ heimana mutimeikɨ. Hikɨta 'ixaheritsixi Kutsuhexi pɨta meheu'enietɨ mepakɨ meta Yawé Muitsexi kemɨtiuta'aitɨakai mɨpaɨ mepɨtekakɨ.
'Anatɨtɨ mɨtiyehane 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie xewitɨ tawarita 'a'uyeikatɨ pɨkahatɨa, Kakaɨyari niukameyatɨtɨ Muitsexi hepaɨ 'anetɨ, Yawé hamatɨana mɨtikuxatakai mehanuyutaxeiyatɨ.
Muitsexi xeikɨa waɨkawa 'inɨari putiwewi mamariwaweme, Yawé ti'aitɨakaku 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie Parahuni hɨxie meta 'iparewiwametemama meta yunaime wahɨxie mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie kiekatari.
Xewitɨ tawarita mɨpaɨ pɨkatiyuriwe tɨrɨkariya kename hexeiya mariweme, meta waɨkawa 'inɨari memuwewieni hipatɨ mepɨkayɨwawe Muitsexi kemɨtiuyuri yunaime 'ixaheritsixi wahɨxie.
